Northwind Securities LLC CIK 0009999202

The Commission instituted settled cease-and-desist proceedings against Northwind Securities LLC for violations of Section 15(c)(3) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and Rule 15c3-3 thereunder.

Northwind Securities LLC consented to the order without admitting or denying the findings. The order imposes a cease-and-desist order and a censure.
